frequency_question: What proportion of major executive branch nominations successfully achieve Senate confirmation?
membership_rule: Includes formal presidential nominations for cabinet and major agency head positions submitted to the U.S. Senate; excludes minor advisory boards or judicial nominations.
window: Within a standard presidential administration term window
coverage_note: 10 named; representative of typical high-level executive nominations which nearly always pass barring extreme controversy
known_gaps: Excludes lower-tier sub-cabinet positions which occasionally stall.
skeleton: Recent presidential administration cabinet/agency head confirmation cycles
multiplier: 10 major nominations examined as a representative sample of high-level executive appointments
validity_reason: Remains stable through the current presidential term structure and Senate confirmation norms.
